CustomField.description: Maximum completion tokens per extraction callout. Replaces LLMExtractionCalloutService.MAX_TOKENS (4096). See that class's header ('RESPONSE SIZING — WHY MAX_TOKENS IS 4096 AND NOT 512') for why — a multi-property email's JSON response can be large, and too low a value truncates the response before it is parsed, losing properties silently.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Max completion tokens per callout. Too low silently truncates a multi-property response.
CustomField.label: Max Tokens
